summary: Full backend + frontend testing of El Foro In Oregon. 23 pytest tests all pass. Frontend public site (Inicio/Enterate/Elecciones/Search) loads, admin login/dashboard/editor/AI Assistant/publish flow all work end-to-end. Admin Elecciones and Media pages render.

issues: Elecciones link is NOT in top navigation (only Inicio/Entérate/Recursos/Oregon Te Informa/Conoce Oregon). Users need to scroll home page banner to reach it. Also no data-testid='nav-elecciones' present, though other nav-* testids are set. Consider adding Elecciones to header nav for discoverability.

Clicking 'Publicar' without first saving as draft does not visibly navigate/redirect (URL stays on /admin/articles/new) - though it does POST successfully. UX could show success toast + redirect to list. When user saves draft first then publishes, everything works and it correctly transitions status.
Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for {DialogContent}' in AI Assistant modal - accessibility warning, add DialogDescription.

action_items: Consider adding 'Elecciones' link (with data-testid=nav-elecciones) to public header navigation since it is a major promoted feature.
Add DialogDescription to Asistente AI dialog to fix accessibility warning.
Optional: after publish-from-new, redirect to list or edit page with clearer success feedback.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py CORS middleware is added AFTER include_router; in Starlette this is OK because middlewares are applied on the ASGI stack at build time, but conventionally add_middleware should be before mounting routes. Not blocking.
content_router routes /public/{kind} are generic; elections_router is included before content_router (per plan) to avoid shadowing. Verified working via tests.
AI action='headline' returns { result: string }; structured actions parse JSON. Confirmed via test_ai_headline (200).
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds demo content on startup. Test created and cleaned up a TEST_ article via API + one TEST article via UI (deleted after).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core flows verified. Public nav does NOT include Elecciones link in the header (design choice or oversight). Admin routes: /admin, /admin/articles, /admin/resources, /admin/oregon-info, /admin/places, /admin/elections, /admin/media, /admin/users. Publish button works but from /new page it needs prior save-draft to fully transition; going save-draft then save-publish works cleanly.
